name: Score Arena
description: A shared scorekeeper for darts and board games, with eight darts modes, ready-made scoring for popular board games, custom games you design yourself, detailed personal statistics and a history-matched Ghost for solo practice.

description.en: A scorekeeper for darts and board games, with statistics and a Ghost for solo practice.

description.de: Ein Punktezähler für Darts und Brettspiele, mit Statistiken und einem Geist zum Alleinüben.
description.es: Marcador para dardos y juegos de mesa, con estadísticas y un Fantasma para practicar a solas.
